description: Run a catalog capability (id from find, input matching its explain schema), e.g. id "email.messages.list" with input { "query": "is:unread" } to read a connected mailbox. Pass `channelId` in the input when several accounts of that kind are connected. Most capabilities are free; paid ones bill the balance. Some capabilities have a daily quota (quotaPerDay in find/explain); beyond it the call fails with 429 rate_limited and resetAt. Async capabilities return a queued job: pass wait=true to block until it finishes, or poll with job.

input.description: Input object per the explain schema

wait.description: Wait for an async job to finish (default false: returns the job; poll it with get_job)

name: do
